metadata.scenario: A client urgently needs to adjust the timing of their therapy session due to a sudden schedule conflict. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, it's Frank Miller. I hope you're doing well. Hi Frank! I'm doing well, thank you. How can I help you? I need to adjust the timing of my therapy session. I have a sudden schedule conflict. Oh no, I’m sorry to hear that. When is your session currently scheduled? It's set for tomorrow at 10 AM with Dr. Rodriguez. Okay, what time do you need to reschedule it to? I was hoping to move it to later in the afternoon, maybe around 3 PM? Let me check Dr. Rodriguez’s schedule for you. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. Alright, it looks like Dr. Rodriguez has availability at 3 PM tomorrow. Does that work for you? Yes, that would be perfect. Thank you! Great! I’ll go ahead and reschedule that for you. I appreciate it. Also, can we talk about my transportation to the endocrinologist? Of course! When is your next appointment? It’s next Thursday at 2 PM. I can arrange transportation for that. Would you like it to be the same driver as last time? Yes, that would be great. They were really nice. Perfect, I’ll note that. So, we have your therapy at 3 PM tomorrow and transportation for next Thursday. Yes, thank you for confirming that! You’re welcome, Frank! Is there anything else you need today? No, that’s all for now. I just wanted to be sure everything was set. Absolutely, I’ll send you a confirmation text for both appointments. Sounds good, thank you! You're very welcome! If you need anything else, don’t hesitate to call. I will. Have a great day, Margaret! You too, Frank! Take care!
